subject: Molecular Chirality Controls Mitochondrial Metabolism by Blocking L-Serine Transport
script: From Agewell Brief: Molecular Chirality Controls Mitochondrial Metabolism by Blocking L-Serine Transport. Mirror-image stereochemistry alters cellular energy pathways as D-serine competes for mitochondrial entry, choking the one-carbon metabolism required by rapidly dividing neural progenitor and glioblastoma stem cells. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
